query: insert into session_chapters (id, session_id, chapter_index, title, summary, start_timestamp_sec, end_timestamp_sec) values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) on conflict (session_id, chapter_index) do update set title = excluded.title, summary = excluded.summary, start_timestamp_sec = excluded.start_timestamp_sec, end_timestamp_sec = excluded.end_timestamp_sec
